title: GAO-01-1015R Survey of NASA’s Lessons Learned Process
summary: GAO HTML representation of the 2001 survey of NASA’s lessons learned process, used as a cautionary audit source showing that a lessons-learned repository can exist while collection, sharing, retrieval, and application remain weak.

source_payload.copyability: not embedded; line locators recorded; archive/hash pass deferred
line_locators_used: L2-L24: procedures require review/apply/document/submit lessons; GAO found fundamental weaknesses and dissatisfaction
L89-L108: NASA definition of lesson learned and LLIS goal to avoid relearning
L112-L170: limited routine identification/collection/sharing, LLIS not primary mechanism, dissatisfaction, barriers/fear of negative lessons
L441-L445: 17.5% applied LLIS lessons and 23% submitted lessons in prior two years
L543-L577: manager suggestions about dissemination, integration, time, and engineering lessons into processes
extraction_notes: One-pass extraction; used as audit/caution source, not as current status of NASA LLIS in 2026.
Temporal caution: this is a 2001 audit and must not be read as current performance evidence without newer review.

handling_notes: Source is used for bounded claim extraction only; do not treat source existence as complete causal explanation.
No long excerpts are embedded; line/page locators and source metadata are retained for re-acquisition.
